title: Frogs go Crazy
description: This datapack allows frogs to eat every mob (besides other frogs) like how they eat slimes and magma cubes.
body:
This minecraft datapack allows frogs to eat every mob (not including themselves) like they eat slimes and magma cubes. This datapack was made because I was bored but I might update it.
